about.title: About Tip Calculator - Restaurant Gratuity Calculation Tool
about.description: The Tip Calculator is a comprehensive dining expense tool designed to help you calculate appropriate tips, split bills among multiple people, and determine total costs for restaurant meals and services. This calculator analyzes bill amounts, service quality, and group sizes to provide accurate tip calculations and bill splitting. Whether you're dining alone or with a group, this tool ensures fair and appropriate tipping.

faq.q: What's the standard tip percentage at restaurants?
faq.a: Standard restaurant tips range from 15-20% of the pre-tax bill. 15% for adequate service, 18% for good service, and 20%+ for excellent service. Some areas or upscale establishments may expect higher percentages.

faq.q: Should I tip on the pre-tax or post-tax amount?
faq.a: Traditionally, tips are calculated on the pre-tax amount since tax isn't part of the service cost. However, some people tip on the post-tax total for simplicity. Both approaches are acceptable.

faq.q: How do I handle tips when splitting bills?
faq.a: Calculate the total tip first, then divide the entire amount (bill + tip) by the number of people. This ensures everyone pays their fair share including an equal portion of the gratuity.

faq.q: When should I tip more or less than standard rates?
faq.a: Tip more (22-25%) for exceptional service, complex orders, or special accommodations. Tip less (10-15%) only for genuinely poor service, but consider speaking with management about service issues instead.
